template_note: TEMPLATE, never passed to core.semantic_knowledge_preparation.prepare_semantic_knowledge_store. That preparer verifies authored_source, construction_scope, permitted_roster and every forbidden_rosters pin by SHA-256, and the authored document's digest only exists after scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_store.py has curated it. scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas_steps.py materialises a RUNNABLE copy of this file BESIDE it in this package (stage3-deltas-v1-release-registration.json) with the real digests. That copy is a REPOSITORY path, not a data-root one: the preparer records a registration by its repo-relative path and refuses one that is not confined to repo_root, exactly as docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-slot-contracts-preparation-registration-v2.json is a repository file. This committed template is never edited in place and its PENDING_ tokens never reach the preparer. Remove this key in the runnable copy. VERSION TAG (S3-5 revision v1r, 2026-09-23): this template names version v1 in three places -- registration_id, authored_source.relpath and output_namespace -- and the materialiser re-points all three onto scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas.sh's DELTA_VERSION_TAG (adv1_to_deltas_steps.py registration --version-tag, fail-closed if a value does not end in '-v1'). The runnable copy is therefore stage3-deltas[-twin]-<tag>-release-registration.json beside this template, one per released store version; an earlier version's registration is never edited or deleted, it is superseded by a readiness note.

what_the_pins_are.source_split_identity_hash: the split identity of the ADV-1 population, i.e. of the committed construction roster docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-advantage-r01c-disagreeing-v1.json. Copied from configs/experiment/slurp-native-stage3-advantage-r01-v1.json population.split_identity_hash once scripts/flights/batch/adv1_prepare.sh has filled it.
what_the_pins_are.authored_source: the RELEASE SOURCE document: scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_store.py --out-source (equivalently scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_source.py over its --out-authored output), which re-envelopes the curated append-only authored-deltas rows verbatim as saea-authored-semantic-knowledge-source-v1 -- the only authored_source shape core.semantic_knowledge_preparation accepts. The curation document itself (schema saea-stage3-authored-deltas-v2) is NOT that shape and must never be pinned here; source-stage3-deltas-v1-wrap-receipt.json beside it pins the curated document it was built from. Its digest is computed by the materialiser, never typed by hand.
what_the_pins_are.construction_scope: the outer construction roster this store's content may be drawn from: the R01C construction subset, exported to the data root in the shape core.semantic_knowledge_preparation._roster parses (the slot-contracts precedent, prepared/SAEA-SLURP-SEMANTIC-AUTHORING-PREPARE-V1/outer-construction-roster.json). A root preparation of S3-5, not produced by this template.
what_the_pins_are.permitted_roster: the rows an authored delta may actually cite: the disagreeing rows of ADV-1, in the same exported shape. A root preparation of S3-5.
what_the_pins_are.forbidden_rosters: the evaluation populations no authored content may touch: TRAIN Fold A, TRAIN Fold B and DEV-1000, pinned exactly as docs/readiness/2026-09-17-slurp-slot-contracts-preparation-registration-v2.json pins them. The materialiser re-verifies each digest against the committed receipt and fails closed on a mismatch.
